import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def analyze_missing_patterns():
    # Create dataset with different missingness mechanisms
    np.random.seed(42)
    n = 500
    
    df = pd.DataFrame({
        'age': np.random.normal(40, 15, n),
        'income': np.random.exponential(50000, n),
        'education': np.random.randint(1, 20, n),
        'satisfaction': np.random.uniform(1, 10, n),
        'health_score': np.random.normal(70, 15, n)
    })
    
    # MCAR: random missingness in age
    df.loc[np.random.random(n) < 0.1, 'age'] = np.nan
    
    # MAR: income missingness depends on education
    income_missing_prob = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-(df['education'] - 10) / 3))
    df.loc[np.random.random(n) < income_missing_prob, 'income'] = np.nan
    
    # MNAR: health_score missing when low
    df.loc[df['health_score'] < np.percentile(df['health_score'], 15), 'health_score'] = np.nan
    
    # Random missing in satisfaction
    df.loc[np.random.random(n) < 0.08, 'satisfaction'] = np.nan
    
    print("=" * 50)
    print("MISSING DATA PATTERN ANALYSIS")
    print("=" * 50)
    
    # 1. Per-column missingness
    print("\n1. Missingness rate per column:")
    missing_rates = df.isnull().mean() * 100
    for col, rate in missing_rates.items():
        print(f"  {col:15s}: {rate:.1f}%")
    
    # 2. Missing patterns
    print("\n2. Common missing patterns:")
    missing_binary = df.isnull().astype(int)
    pattern_col = missing_binary.astype(str).agg(''.join, axis=1)
    patterns = pattern_col.value_counts()
    for pattern, count in patterns.head(5).items():
        cols_missing = [df.columns[i] for i, c in enumerate(pattern) if c == '1']
        print(f"  {cols_missing}: {count} rows ({count/n*100:.1f}%)")
    
    # 3. Missingness correlation matrix
    print("\n3. Missingness indicator correlations:")
    missing_corr = missing_binary.corr()
    print(missing_corr.round(2))
    
    # 4. Mechanism classification hints
    print("\n4. Suspected missingness mechanisms:")
    print("  age: MCAR (random pattern)")
    print("  income: MAR (depends on education)")
    print("  health_score: MNAR (depends on own value)")

analyze_missing_patterns()
